quote: Travellers who require that every nation should resemble their native country, had better stay at home.
source: Mary Wollstonecraft, Letters Written During a Short Residence in Sweden, Norway, and Denmark, Letter V (J. Johnson, 1796)

evidence.where: The full text of Project Gutenberg ebook 3529 was fetched and searched; the sentence was read in place in Letter V, with the paragraph around it about writers who consider the history of man on an enlarged scale and about blaming a people for their manners.
evidence.edition: Letters Written During a Short Residence in Sweden, Norway, and Denmark (J. Johnson, 1796); Project Gutenberg ebook 3529, printing the Cassell’s National Library text of 1889
evidence.locator: Letter V, in the paragraph following the remark on writers who have considered the history of man on a more enlarged scale

reason: Word for word in Letter V, including the double l of Travellers and the comma before had better, which many web copies drop. Wollstonecraft is new to the year and the book is a published volume of letters, so Correspondence is the right tag and it carries the month’s travel theme without preaching.
